item.title: Self-Hosted Container CNI Plugins: Linux Bridge vs IPvLAN vs Macvlan Deep Dive
item.description: Container networking is the foundation of any self-hosted infrastructure. The Container Network Interface (CNI) defines a standard for connecting containers to networks, and the choice of CNI plugin determines how your containers communicate with each other, the host, and external networks.
